description: Canonical shared property definitions across all information units.

ael_applied_pressure.description: Returns the applied pressure for the AEL calculations.

ael_average_external_pressure.description: Returns the average external pressure for the AEL calculations.

ael_bulk_modulus_reuss.description: Returns the bulk modulus calculated, using the Reuss method, by AEL.

ael_bulk_modulus_voigt.description: Returns the bulk modulus calculated, using the Voigt method, by AEL.

ael_compliance_tensor.description: Returns the compliance tensor calculated by AEL.

ael_debye_temperature.description: Returns the Debye temperature calculated by AEL.

ael_elastic_anisotropy.description: Returns the elastic anisotropy calculated by AEL.

ael_pughs_modulus_ratio.description: Returns the Pugh's modulus ratio calculated by AEL.

ael_shear_modulus_reuss.description: Returns the shear modulus calculated, using the Reuss method, by AEL.

ael_shear_modulus_voigt.description: Returns the shear modulus calculated, using the Voigt method, by AEL.

ael_speed_sound_average.description: Returns the average speed of sound calculated by AEL

ael_speed_sound_longitudinal.description: Returns the longitudinal speed of sound calculated by AEL

ael_speed_sound_transverse.description: Returns the transverse speed of sound calculated by AEL

ael_stiffness_tensor.description: Returns the stiffness tensor calculated by AEL

ael_youngs_modulus_vrh.description: Returns the Young modulus calculated, using the Voigt-Reuss-Hill average, by AEL.

aflow_prototype_label_orig.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype label for the unrelaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_label_relax.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype label for the relaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_parameters_orig.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter labels and values for the unrelaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_parameters_relax.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter labels and values for the relaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_params_list_orig.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter labels for the unrelaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_params_list_relax.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter labels for the relaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_params_values_orig.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter values for the unrelaxed structure.

aflow_prototype_params_values_relax.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype parameter values for the relaxed structure.

agl_acoustic_debye.description: Returns the acoustic Debye temperature calculated by AGL.

agl_bulk_modulus_isothermal_300_k.description: Returns the isothermal bulk modulus calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_bulk_modulus_static_300_k.description: Returns the static bulk modulus calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_debye.description: Returns the Debye temperature calculated by AGL.

agl_gruneisen.description: Returns the Grüneisen parameter calculated by AGL.

agl_heat_capacity_cp_300_k.description: Returns the heat capacity per cell, at constant pressure, calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_heat_capacity_cv_300_k.description: Returns the heat capacity per cell, at constant volume, calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_poisson_ratio_source.description: Returns the source of the Poisson ratio used for AGL calculations.

agl_thermal_conductivity_300_k.description: Returns the thermal conductivity calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_thermal_expansion_300_k.description: Returns the thermal expansion coefficient calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_vibrational_entropy_300_k_atom.description: Returns the vibrational entropy per atom calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_vibrational_entropy_300_k_cell.description: Returns the vibrational entropy per cell calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_vibrational_free_energy_300_k_atom.description: Returns the vibrational free energy per atom calculated by AGL at 300 K.

agl_vibrational_free_energy_300_k_cell.description: Returns the vibrational free energy per cell calculated by AGL at 300 K.

atomic_numbers.description: Atomic numbers for atoms in the structure

atoms_per_species.description: Returns the number of atoms per type in the simulation cell.

aurl.description: Returns the AFLOWLIB uniform resource locator (AURL) for the entry.

authors.description: Returns the name (not necessarily an individual) and affiliation associated with authorship of the data.

bader_atomic_volumes.description: Returns the volume of each atom calculated by the Atoms in Molecules (AIM) Bader analysis.

bader_net_charges.description: Returns the partial charge of each atom calculated by the Atoms in Molecules (AIM) Bader analysis.

band_gap_gbfs.description: Predicted electronic band gap using GBFS LightGBM model

band_gap_gbfs2d.description: Predicted electronic band gap for 2D layered materials using GBFS-2D LightGBM model with van der Waals detection

band_gap_type.description: Returns the electronic band gap type.

bravais_lattice_lattice_system.description: Returns the Bravais lattice of the lattice system for the relaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_lattice_system_orig.description: Returns the Bravais lattice of the lattice system for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_lattice_type.description: Returns the lattice centering type for the relaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_lattice_type_orig.description: Returns the lattice centering type for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_lattice_variation_type.description: Returns the Bravais lattice variation of the lattice system for the relaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_lattice_variation_type_o.description: Returns the Bravais lattice variation of the lattice system for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_orig.description: Returns the Bravais lattice of the crystal for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_lattice_relax.description: Returns the Bravais lattice of the crystal for the relaxed structure.

bravais_superlattice_lattice_system.description: Returns the Bravais superlattice of the lattice system for the relaxed structure.

bravais_superlattice_lattice_system_orig.description: Returns the Bravais superlattice of the lattice system for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_superlattice_lattice_type.description: Returns the Bravais superlattice centering type for the relaxed structure.

bravais_superlattice_lattice_type_orig.description: Returns the Bravais superlattice centering type for the unrelaxed structure.

bravais_superlattice_lattice_variation_t.description: Returns the Bravais superlattice variation of the lattice system for the relaxed structure.
Returns the Bravais superlattice variation of the lattice system for the unrelaxed structure

calculation_code.description: Returns the software name and version used to perform the calculation.

calculation_cores.description: Returns the number of CPUs used by the calculation.

calculation_memory.description: Returns the maximum RAM used by the calculation.

calculation_time.description: Returns the total time taken by the calculation.

corresponding_contact.description: Returns the name (not necessarily an individual) and affiliation associated with the data origin concerning correspondence about data.

crystal_class.description: Returns the crystal class for the relaxed structure.

crystal_class_orig.description: Returns the crystal class for the unrelaxed structure.

crystal_family.description: Returns the crystal family for the relaxed structure.

crystal_family_orig.description: Returns the crystal family for the unrelaxed structure.

crystal_system.description: Returns the crystal system for the relaxed structure.

crystal_system_orig.description: Returns the crystal system for the unrelaxed structure.

data_api.description: Returns the REST API version for the entry.

data_language.description: Gives the language of the data in AFLOWLIB.

data_source.description: Returns the data source for the entry.

database_catalog.description: Returns the database name for the calculation.

delta_electronic_energy_convergence.description: Returns the change in total energy from the last step of the self-consistent field (SCF) iteration.

delta_electronic_energy_threshold.description: Returns the threshold for the self-consistent field (SCF) convergence.

dft_type.description: Returns the level of theory used in the calculation, i.e., pseudopotential type, exchange-correlation functional used, and use of GW.

dielectric_constant_gbfs.description: Predicted dielectric constant using GBFS LightGBM model

dos_ef.description: Density of states at Fermi level (PBEsol)

dos_ef_scan.description: Density of states at Fermi level (SCAN)

eentropy_atom.description: Returns the electronic entropy per atom used to converge the calculation.

eentropy_cell.description: Returns the electronic entropy per cell used to converge the calculation.

electron_mobility_gbfs.description: Predicted electron mobility using GBFS LightGBM model (log10 scaled internally, returned as actual value)

elements.description: List of unique chemical elements present

energy_above_hull_r2scan.description: Distance from convex hull using r2SCAN functional

energy_cell.description: Returns the total ab initio energy per cell.

energy_cutoff.description: Return the plane-wave energy cut-off used for the calculation.

enthalpy_formation_atom.description: Returns the formation enthalpy per atom.

enthalpy_formation_cell.description: Returns the formation enthalpy per cell.

files.description: Returns the input and output files used in the simulation.

formation_energy_gbfs.description: Predicted formation energy per atom using GBFS LightGBM model

formation_energy_r2scan.description: Formation energy per atom using r2SCAN functional

geometry.description: Returns the lattice parameters of the relaxed simulation cell.

geometry_orig.description: Returns the lattice parameters of the unrelaxed simulation cell.

hole_mobility_gbfs.description: Predicted hole mobility using GBFS LightGBM model (log10 scaled internally, returned as actual value)

is_metal_gbfs.description: Predicted metal/non-metal classification using GBFS LightGBM classifier

is_metal_gbfs2d.description: Predicted metal/non-metal classification for 2D layered materials using GBFS-2D LightGBM classifier with van der Waals detection

is_stable_gbfs2d.description: Predicted structural stability for 2D layered materials using GBFS-2D LightGBM classifier with van der Waals detection

kpoints_bands_nkpts.description: Returns the number of points, between the high-symmetry k-points, used for the band structure calculation.

kpoints_bands_path.description: Returns the high-symmetry k-point path used for the band structure calculation.

kpoints_relax.description: Returns the k-point grid used for the structural relaxation calculation.

kpoints_static.description: Returns the k-point grid used for the static calculation.

lattice_system_orig.description: Returns the lattice system for the unrelaxed structure.

lattice_system_relax.description: Returns the lattice system for the relaxed structure.

lattice_variation_orig.description: Returns the lattice variation for the unrelaxed structure.

lattice_variation_relax.description: Returns the lattice variation for the relaxed structure.

ldau_j.description: Returns the J parameters of the DFT+U calculation.

ldau_l.description: Returns The orbitals of the DFT+U calculation.

ldau_type.description: Returns the type of DFT+U calculation performed.

ldau_u.description: Returns the U parameters of the DFT+U calculation.

matching_entries.description: Returns the AFLOWLIB entries that matched the search criterion.

matching_entries_count.description: Returns the number AFLOWLIB entries that matched the search criterion.

natoms.description: Number of atoms in unit cell

nbondxx.description: Returns the nearest neighbors distances for the relaxed structure.

node_c_p_u_cores.description: Returns information about the number of CPUs on the node/cluster where the calculation was performed.

node_c_p_u_m_hz.description: Returns information about the speed of CPUs on the node/cluster where the calculation was performed.

node_c_p_u_model.description: Returns information about the model of CPUs on the node/cluster where the calculation was performed.

node_r_a_m_g_b.description: Returns information about the RAM on the node/cluster where the calculation was performed.

num_atoms.description: Number of atoms in the structure

p_v_atom.description: Returns the pressure multiplied by volume per atom for the relaxed structure.

p_v_cell.description: Returns the pressure multiplied by volume per atom for the relaxed structure.

pearson_symbol_orig.description: Returns the Pearson symbol for the unrelaxed structure.

pearson_symbol_relax.description: Returns the Pearson symbol for the relaxed structure.

pearson_symbol_superlattice.description: Returns the Pearson symbol of the superlattice for the relaxed structure.

pearson_symbol_superlattice_orig.description: Returns the Pearson symbol of the superlattice for the unrelaxed structure.

point_group_hermann_mauguin.description: Returns the point group, in Hermann-Mauguin notation, for the relaxed structure.

point_group_hermann_mauguin_orig.description: Returns the point group, in Hermann-Mauguin notation, for the unrelaxed structure.

point_group_orbifold.description: Returns the point group orbifold for the relaxed structure.

point_group_orbifold_orig.description: Returns the point group orbifold for the unrelaxed structure.

point_group_order.description: Returns the point group order for the relaxed structure.

point_group_order_orig.description: Returns the point group order for the unrelaxed structure.

point_group_schoenflies.description: Returns the point group, in Schoenflies notation, for the relaxed structure.

point_group_schoenflies_orig.description: Returns the point group, in Schoenflies notation, for the unrelaxed structure.

point_group_structure.description: Returns the point group structure for the relaxed structure.

point_group_structure_orig.description: Returns the point group structure for the unrelaxed structure

point_group_type.description: Returns the point group type for the relaxed structure.

point_group_type_orig.description: Returns the point group type for the unrelaxed structure.

positions_cartesian.description: Returns the Cartesian coordinates of the atoms for the relaxed structure.

positions_fractional.description: Returns the fractional coordinates of the atoms for the relaxed structure.

postprocessing_loop.description: Returns information about the type of post-processing that was performed.

pressure.description: Returns the hydrostatic pressure on the simulation cell for the unrelaxed structure.

pressure_final.description: Returns the hydrostatic pressure on the simulation cell for the relaxed structure.

pressure_residual.description: Returns the hydrostatic pressure, corrected by the Pulay stress, on the simulation cell for the relaxed structure.

prototype.description: Returns the AFLOW prototype for the unrelaxed structure.

pulay_stress.description: Returns the Pulay stress correcton for the calculation.

reciprocal_geometry.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice parameters of the relaxed simulation cell.

reciprocal_geometry_orig.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice parameters of the unrelaxed simulation cell.

reciprocal_lattice_type.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice centering type for the relaxed structure.

reciprocal_lattice_type_orig.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice centering type for the unrelaxed structure.

reciprocal_lattice_variation_type.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice centering type variation for the relaxed structure.

reciprocal_lattice_variation_type_orig.description: Returns the reciprocal lattice centering type variation for the unrelaxed structure.

reciprocal_volume_cell.description: Returns the volume of the reciprocal cell for the relaxed structure.

reciprocal_volume_cell_orig.description: Returns the volume of the reciprocal cell for the unrelaxed structure.

relaxed_cif.description: Relaxed CIF output from MatterSim, returned either as CIF contents or as a saved local file path when output_dir is provided

relaxed_energy.description: Total energy after MatterSim structure relaxation

relaxed_forces.description: Forces on atoms after MatterSim structure relaxation

relaxed_stress.description: Stress tensor after MatterSim structure relaxation

repository_version.description: Returns the version of the AFLOW post-processor which generated the entry in the library.

sg.description: Returns the space groups for the structure, before the first relaxation step (unrelaxed), after the first relaxation step and after the last relaxation step (relaxed), using a loose tolerance.

sg2.description: Returns the space groups for the structure, before the first relaxation step (unrelaxed), after the first relaxation step and after the last relaxation step (relaxed), using a tight (default) tolerance.

slme.description: Spectroscopic Limited Maximum Efficiency for solar cells

spacegroup_orig.description: Returns the space group for the unrelaxed structure.

species_pp.description: Returns the pseudopotential of the species.

species_pp_version.description: Returns the pseudopotential version of the species.

species_pp_z_v_a_l.description: Returns the number of valence electrons of the species.

spillage.description: Spillage value for topological material screening

spin_atom.description: Returns the magnetization of the simulation cell per atom

spin_d.description: Returns the magnetic moment on each atom.

spin_d_magmom_orig.description: Returns the magnetic moment on each atom of the unrelaxed structure.

spin_f.description: Returns the magnetization of the simulation cell, at the Fermi energy.

sponsors.description: Returns information about funding agencies and other sponsors for the entry.

stoichiometry.description: Returns the normalized composition of the structure.

valence_cell_iupac.description: Returns the sum of the valence electrons, based on IUPAC standards, of the atoms in the simulation cell.

valence_cell_std.description: Returns the sum of the valence electrons, based on the outermost shell(s), of the atoms in the simulation cell.

volume_atom.description: Returns the volume per atom of the simulation cell for the relaxed structure.

workflow_version.description: Returns the version number of AFLOW used to perform the calculation.

wyckoff_letters.description: Returns the Wyckoff letters of each site for the relaxed structure.

wyckoff_letters_orig.description: Returns the Wyckoff letters of each site for the unrelaxed structure.

wyckoff_multiplicities.description: Returns the Wyckoff multiplicity of each site for the relaxed structure.

wyckoff_multiplicities_orig.description: Returns the Wyckoff multiplicity of each site for the unrelaxed structure.

wyckoff_positions.description: The Wyckoff positions of each site for the relaxed structure.

wyckoff_positions_orig.description: The Wyckoff positions of each site for the unrelaxed structure.

wyckoff_site_symmetries.description: Returns the Wyckoff symmetry of each site for the relaxed structure.

wyckoff_site_symmetries_orig.description: Returns the Wyckoff symmetry of each site for the unrelaxed structure.
